result.rationale: In the sync branch, refreshOAuthTokens returns the raw fetch Response (`return response;` from fetch to CALCOM_CREDENTIAL_SYNC_ENDPOINT), while Zoho Bigin/ZohoCRM/Hubspot callers immediately access `.data` (e.g. `if (!tokenInfo.data.error)`, `hubspotRefreshToken.refresh_token`) and Google accesses `res?.data` — the diff shows no adaptation, so those callers would break when credential sync is enabled.
